summary: Captain Zara detects an anomalous signal from within the Veil Nebula and must decide whether to investigate.

scenes.setting: Bridge of the Meridian, night cycle
scenes.purpose: Establish the protagonist and the inciting incident
key_events: Zara is reviewing old mission logs when an alert sounds
Kai reports an anomalous signal from inside the Veil Nebula
The signal appears to be structured — possibly artificial

scenes.purpose: Show Zara's internal conflict about the mission
key_events: Zara inspects the ship's systems, checking if they can handle the nebula
She recalls the failed mission that haunts her
She resolves to investigate despite the risk

scenes.setting: Bridge of the Meridian, approach to the Veil Nebula
scenes.purpose: Begin the journey into the unknown
key_events: Zara gives the order to change course toward the signal
Kai plots the course and warns of nebula hazards
The Meridian enters the outer edge of the Veil Nebula
